#
# After snapping the three control points to the fixed grid of the given integer scale, the arc is DEGEN (snapped points collinear), PRESERVE (snapped circumcentre also on the grid) or DENSIFY (snapped centre off-grid). Computed exactly (integer divisibility). Covers on-grid arcs, off-grid centres at fine scales, and collinear/degenerate snaps over several scales.
